text:
alex: Heads up — PR #4521 showing repeated SAST/DAST alerts and we're not seeing KMS audit entries for the scanner service account. Repro steps below, anyone available? :eyes:

scan-bot: SAST: 12 findings (run id: action-run-2026-03-21-8872)
DAST: 3 findings
webhook delivery: 202 -> 500 retry x2
kms: decrypt called for key proj-scan-key — no audit entry found

maria: On it. Which service account is the scanner using? If decrypts aren't in audit logs we can't trace secret usage.

alex: scanner SA = scan-runner-prod@infra. Build link: https://ci.example.com/runs/action-run-2026-03-21-8872
Snippet:
```
[2026-03-21T12:03:14Z] scanner: request decrypt key=proj-scan-key caller=scan-runner-prod
[2026-03-21T12:03:14Z] kms: decrypt success key_id=proj-scan-key request_id=abcd-1234
[2026-03-21T12:03:14Z] audit: NoAuditEntryFound key_id=proj-scan-key
[2026-03-21T12:03:18Z] webhook: callback https://dast-callback.prod 202 then 500
```

james: We've seen the DAST webhook flapping earlier today — callback returned 202 (accepted) then intermittent 5xx causing retry storms and duplicate findings in the UI. We should add dedupe using an idempotency key on callbacks.

leah: Also noting RBAC: the scanner SA currently has broader perms than necessary (iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator + storage.admin). Proposal: restrict to kms.decrypt + storage.objects.get and remove tokenCreator. I'll open a ticket and apply a short-lived revoke if needed.

maria: Short-term mitigation: rotate the scanner credentials and issue ephemeral grants via our ephemeral-keystore service. Long-term: pipe KMS audit to log-archive and index decrypt events so we can query them. Also add a CloudWatch/GCP audit sink alert if decrypts occur without audit entries.

alex: I'll rotate creds now and flip the scanner to use ephemeral tokens. Also propose changing premerge gating thresholds to only fail on high severity to cut noise while we stabilise.

scan-bot: Created ticket INFSEC-3421: "DAST webhook dedupe + KMS audit sink" — assigned to @leah, ETA 48h :white_check_mark:

james: Quick GH Actions snippet for idempotency header (temp fix):
```
- name: Inject idempotency key
  run: |
    echo "IDEMP=scan-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ matrix.os }}" >> $GITHUB_ENV
  env:
    SCAN_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.SCAN_API_KEY }}
```

leah: Thanks — I'll post RBAC change doc to /docs/infsec/scanner-rbac.md and add the narrow policy. Will also attach the rotation log when done. :+1:

alex: sgtm. @sre-oncall please watch for more webhook 5xxs or scan spikes. If we see retries > 10/min we'll rollback callback endpoint.

maria: Follow-up: we should also add an automated test in our CI that validates audit entries exist for decrypt calls (mock KMS + assert audit sink). I'll draft a test and link the PR to INFSEC-3421.

leah: I'll start the RBAC change in staging now. Will update ticket with timestamps and audit evidence.
